verdict.rationale: Superset documents automations that run an agent prompt on a cron-like schedule into a live workspace. These can be managed through the CLI, SDK and MCP server, so time-triggered actions are well covered. Event triggers are thin: user-defined setup/teardown scripts run on workspace lifecycle events, and agent finish or pause only raises a notification. Missing for 10: a general event-driven rule engine (e.g. triggers on PR, commit, task or agent-completion events firing actions), documentation of conditional rule definitions, and independent hands-on corroboration of automations.
